falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the August 2024 high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, which requires price to remain below prior resistance. This would signal a new uptrend rather than a bottoming phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: The 7-day average of spot BTC ETF net flows turns positive and exceeds +$500M cumulative over any 5-day rolling window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained institutional buying pressure contradicts the HOLD signal and bottoming thesis, which assumes continued outflows or neutral flows. This would indicate accumulation rather than distribution.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC funding rate on Binance perpetuals exceeds 0.05% (8-hour rate) for 5 consecutive 8-hour intervals
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistently elevated positive funding would show leveraged longs are aggressively piling in, contradicting the low-blowoff-score (41) and HOLD verdict. This would suggest a blowoff top is forming, not a bottom.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
